automated_alerting_status: MANUAL REVIEW ONLY — Automated Alerting Not Configured (No Paid Observability Subscription)

signals.name: Deployment Failure
signals.threshold_or_review_condition: Vercel build or deployment status != Ready
signals.first_response: Inspect Vercel build log and check Turbopack compilation error
signals.escalation: Escalate to Lead Developer if compilation error relates to source code
signals.evidence_required: Vercel deployment inspect output and build log tail

signals.name: Build Failure
signals.first_response: Check TypeScript errors or static asset compilation failures

signals.name: Health-Ready Failure
signals.threshold_or_review_condition: GET /api/health/ready returns status != 200 or database != ok
signals.first_response: Verify Neon database status via neonctl and test direct connection
signals.escalation: Escalate to Database Administrator if database is unreachable
signals.rollback_trigger: Health check failure > 3 consecutive probes post-deploy
signals.evidence_required: /api/health/ready JSON response and database connectivity logs

signals.name: Database Connection Failure
signals.threshold_or_review_condition: Connection pool timeout or sslmode verification error logged
signals.first_response: Verify Neon connection pooler health and active client count
signals.escalation: Escalate to Neon Support if pooler service is degraded
signals.evidence_required: Neon pooler metrics and application error stack traces

signals.name: Authentication Failure Spike
signals.source: Better Auth Session Logs / Vercel Function Logs
signals.threshold_or_review_condition: HTTP 401 rate > 10% of total traffic over 5 minutes
signals.first_response: Inspect session token validation errors and verify BETTER_AUTH_SECRET matching
signals.escalation: Escalate to Product Owner if valid sessions are being invalidated
signals.rollback_trigger: Widespread auth failure affecting > 50% of active sessions post-deploy

signals.name: Unexpected HTTP 5xx Spike
signals.source: Vercel Project Analytics / Runtime Function Logs
signals.threshold_or_review_condition: HTTP 5xx rate > 1% of total requests over 5 minutes
signals.first_response: Filter Vercel logs by status 500-599 and extract correlation IDs
signals.escalation: Escalate to Lead Developer for emergency patch or rollback
signals.evidence_required: Vercel function execution log with correlation IDs

signals.name: Authorization Anomaly / Tenant Denial Spike
signals.threshold_or_review_condition: HTTP 403 or HTTP 404 rate on /reports or /internal > 5% of requests
signals.first_response: Inspect request parameters for cross-tenant business ID mismatch
signals.escalation: Escalate to Lead Developer if entitlement logic is misconfigured
signals.rollback_trigger: False-positive entitlement block affecting valid PRO users

signals.name: Migration Failure
signals.first_response: Inspect migration lock status and identify failing SQL DDL statement
signals.rollback_trigger: Immediate abort of deployment pipeline before application code release

signals.name: Connection Exhaustion
signals.threshold_or_review_condition: Active connection pool utilization > 90% of pool capacity
signals.first_response: Inspect un-closed client connections and verify connection pooler configuration
signals.escalation: Escalate to DevOps Lead for pooler max_connections adjustment
signals.rollback_trigger: Sustained connection exhaustion causing request timeouts

signals.name: Latency Regression
signals.source: Vercel Web Vitals / Bounded Reliability Probes
signals.first_response: Analyze serverless function execution time and database query duration
signals.escalation: Escalate to DevOps for function memory allocation increase
signals.rollback_trigger: p95 latency > 5000ms affecting user flow completion
